I tried the Next/pages version — hitting Next swapped the first twenty out for items 21–40 with a "Page 2 of 6" marker. It works fine and I always know which page I'm on.

But between the two, I'd pick the continuous "Show 20 more" one for everyday use. When I'm looking through my bookmarks I'm usually skimming, half-remembering something, and I like being able to just keep scrolling one long list and pull in more as I go without losing the stuff I already scrolled past. With the pages version, the earlier items disappear when I move on, so if I realize "wait, that thing was a few back," I have to click back to the previous page to find it. The one continuous list feels more like browsing my own collection; flipping pages feels like more work.

So my choice is the "Show 20 more" continuous list. What's next?
